Keep each product type with one partner unless there is a reason. Splitting orders across partners makes problems harder to trace.

count adds up from the issues table. Look at it every month next to their order count. A partner with more than one issue in fifty orders needs a conversation, and a second sample of the problem product. If quality stays uneven, move the listing to another partner and order a fresh sample first.
Orders of ten or more for a shop or an event go through the partner's bulk service, if they have one, at a lower base cost. Order one sample first, confirm sizes in writing, and allow an extra week.
Never sell something you have not held. A sample costs a few dollars; a bad print costs the customer and the review.

If it fails, adjust the file (usually colours) and order another sample.
Partners change blanks, inks and printers without much notice. Order a fresh sample of your best seller from each partner every six months, and whenever customers start mentioning colour or fit.
Mockups must match the real product. If your sample's colour is a little darker than the mockup, darken the mockup or adjust the file. A customer who gets what they saw does not write in.
Base cost plus shipping plus marketplace and payment fees should leave at least 35 percent. The
column shows price against base cost; take about 12 points off it for fees on the marketplace and 4 on your own site. Listings below the line need a higher price, a cheaper blank, or retiring.
Only list designs you own or have rights to print. Commissioned designs need a written agreement giving the shop full rights; record it on the design.
Print-on-demand items are made for one customer, so the rule is simple: fix our mistakes fast, be clear about everything else.
Misprint, damage, wrong item or lost parcel: we reprint or refund. No need to send it back.
Wrong size chosen or changed mind: we cannot take it back, because it was made for them. We offer 15 percent off a reorder in the right size.
Report problems within 30 days of delivery, with a photo.
